title: Copy as PNG changes some text in Mozilla/Zen
reason: The first reply suggests Firefox font-loading timing may mirror a Safari export issue; a maintainer using Firefox could not reproduce it and requests exact steps or a minimal file before investigation. Images were not independently replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: Clipboard raster text fidelity is a useful cross-browser lead, but no Varve reproduction or source inspection was performed.

title: Simulate shift modifier with a held second touch on mobile
reason: Proposes mapping a held second touch to Shift after a disambiguation delay. The only response says this cannot be done, rejecting the proposal without technical elaboration.

varveAssessment.assessment: No touch-modifier behavior change is supported by this short rejected upstream request.

title: Move pressure simulation from the ink algorithm into the drawing gesture
reason: Suggests recording simulated pressure during gestures instead of recalculating it during rendering, trading larger point data for simpler resize and render behavior. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses a distinct stroke/rendering pipeline; any pressure model change would require local profiling and serialized-data review.

title: Delay the appearance of the "back to content" button
reason: Requests delaying the off-viewport Back to Content helper to avoid flicker during normal camera motion. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A small UX-polish candidate; no equivalent Varve helper was inspected in this assessment.

title: Dotcom has accessibility issues in sign-in and CTAs
reason: Records a focused audit of the anonymous/sign-in flow, including unnamed dialog and authentication errors not associated with their inputs. The only reply offers to implement high-priority items; no merged resolution is confirmed.

varveAssessment.assessment: The findings concern the hosted dotcom sign-in experience; Varve website/app authentication accessibility was not audited by this issue review.

title: MCP app iframe CSP blocks cdn.tldraw.com — exec tool always times out after first use
reason: The final reply confirms #9513 allowed cdn.tldraw.com in the MCP widget's connectDomains and forwarded exec results between sessions. Earlier comments report the issue and provide confirmation from another user.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream MCP widget CSP/session integration fix, not a Varve iframe defect.

title: Cancel any modifier timeouts on pointer down
reason: Describes a race where delayed modifier-key release clearing leaves a just-released modifier active when the next pointer interaction begins. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A potentially general pointer/keyboard state edge; no Varve source path or reproduction was examined here.

title: Convert pages named --- into dividers
reason: Requests rendering pages named `---` as nonselectable separators in the hosted page list. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a hosted page-list presentation convention and no Varve page-management change was evaluated.

title: Improve the pen/stylus drawing experience
reason: Bundles hover-pen cursor indicators, more accessible style controls, and left/right style-panel placement. Discussion clarifies that the request concerns hover indicators on hardware that supports hover; no delivery status is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: These are distinct hardware and layout features requiring Varve device support and UX review; no local behavior was inspected.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for app-level file actions
reason: Requests keyboard access to hosted file actions such as new file, search, and copy link. The reply distinguishes within-file and cross-file search shortcuts and notes browser shortcut conflicts for new-file creation; no settled map is shown.

varveAssessment.assessment: Hosted workspace actions are outside Varve's canvas shortcut map; no local shortcut change is inferred.
